demoLoop.intent: Install a local demo module, bind typed rights to an agent and user, run one synthetic workflow, inspect plan, policy, receipt and audit evidence, then roll it back.

themeReclassification.theme: Secure Local Prototype V1 and Private Alpha evidence
themeReclassification.rationale: Historical local evidence remains accepted and should not receive more invariant layers.
The release must demonstrate intent, typed plan, approval, module action, receipt, audit and rollback.
Extensibility is central to the corrected product goal.
It is valuable reference evidence but not a hard PoC gate when demo-grade adapters prove the extension lifecycle.

themeReclassification.theme: Admin AI intent and policy model
themeReclassification.rationale: Admin AI may be shown as dry-run planning and approval explanation with fail-closed authority boundaries.

themeReclassification.theme: G00 G01 G14 publication rights owner authority
themeReclassification.rationale: Publication, rights and owner authority remain separate gates.

themeReclassification.theme: Production ERP CRM mail collaboration integrations
themeReclassification.rationale: Perfect production integrations are later validation, not early PoC evidence.

themeReclassification.theme: P13 overload and broad performance claims
themeReclassification.rationale: The historical host-safety blocker remains real for performance/load claims but does not block the bounded PoC demo.

themeReclassification.theme: Operations workbench UI and external channel launch
themeReclassification.rationale: Current artifacts inform onboarding and explainability but do not authorize launch, accounts or live users.
